name: rules-prophecy-discard
description: Rules audit (deliberate improvement over the original): Prophecy of Ixth - 'When the owner of this card uses PRODUCTION, they discard this card unless they produce 2 or more fighters.' The original only reminded ('its removal is not automated'). Ral Nel is elected Prophecy of Ixth, then produces a carrier and a destroyer (no fighters) at 307: the law must be discarded (DeleteButtonsButtonHandler.resolveProphecyOfIxth).
